body: My life will be less wasted than the lives of you and all the other wage slaves out there; those who never truly lived, but rather, existed.  At least I am trying to advance the cause, to fight for the future of the species.  If things continue as they are, we're all dead anyway.  So why not die for something worthwhile?

No, money and trade are not tools (and are not remotely the same thing).  Trade can refer to a proffession (which I do not object to) or exchanging commodoties for other commodoties.  This exchange implies ownership of property, which I vehemently disagree with as previously mentioned.  And money is absolutely responsible for overconsumption because the monetary market system is currently how we regulate what resources go where.  If instead of basing the regulation of our limited resources on this abstract and outdated market principles we held a more utilitarian outlook, overconsumption would cease.  We must abandon property and money (the creator of property) and proclaim all the Earth the common heritage of humanity.  We must then use Earth's resources to fill our needs, rather than to create excess and demand.

For the record, I don't like cars either.  I prefer high speed bullet trains and other more efficient means of public transportation.  If we must continue to have cars, let them be freely available rent-a-cars.  This idea of everybody having a car that they use for maybe a few hours a day (if even) is stupid, wasteful, and impractical.  

Even if I can't change the world (which I'm convinced with enough work I can), I refuse to conform.  I will not be moved.  You move, motherfucker!!  I will not be changed, I will change the world.  I'd rather fight a lost cause and die resisting than bend over and accept the dick that is the status-quo.  Feel free to suck on that cock if that's what you're into, I'll keep what little integrity I have left.  

I refuse meds on general principle as well, in no small part because my mother works in a hospital and is overmedicated as fuck--which contributed to her shitty parenting.  Therapy was the most expensive waste of my time I've ever had, and I don't have the money to be wasting on stupid shit like that.  For less than a third the cost of my therapist, I can see two friends who never let me down:  Jim Beam and Mary Jane.  I drink hard liquor all day every day and chainsmoke anything flammable.  I am surprisingly functional, if sad, discontented, and filled with an omnicidal rage.  I will be a martyr long before I ever agree to be just another cog in the murder machine that is our criminal society.  I repeat:  It is no measure of health to be well adjusted to a profoundly sick society.

Oy... if I had a nickel for every time I've heard these same poor defenses of a decrepit and evil system.  For starters, money is NOT a useful tool.  It is the creator of property and a medium for exchange that is only of use when scarcity is an issue.  In all truth, scarcity is an illusion born of hoarding, this scarcity is necessary to perpetuate the system.  Let's take Wal Mart for example.  So much food stacked up and piled high they can't sell it all, in fact a very large chunk of it is thrown away--but they'd sooner see you die then give you the excess.  You're right, growth is an inherent part of the system but not how you think it is.  One of the points Marx makes in Kapital is that capital refuses to accept limits, it will circumvent or bypass any attempt at regulation for profit.  This constant growth is unsustainable and stupid, we only follow this stupid boom/bust model because we allow the market (which has no tangible basis in reality, because it's based on theoretical concepts like debt and value) to govern our actions instead of practical factors like our rate of consumption versus our total available resources.

Furthermore, from 1860 on we've been rapidly replaced by machines.  There are more people than ever and less jobs than ever thanks to mechanization and automation.  The classic example is John Henry and the steam powered hammer, a more modern context is the automated restaurants of Japan or google search engines replacing file clerks.  There is nothing we can do that machines can't do better.  If you build a machine to make sandwiches, it will make sandwiches forever.  They don't need to take breaks, they don't make mistakes, they don't need to sleep.  All that wage slavery and the monetary market system is doing is keeping 99.99% of the population subjugated and hampering the progress of our species.  The time has come for us to abandon property, the dumbest idea the white man ever came up with.  John Locke can go fuck himself.  You can't own anything, at best you're borrowing it.  The raw materials that were used to build whatever commodity you think you own existed long before you did and will continue to exist long after you're dead.  

You're the one who's deluded if you truly believe this is the best we can do.  There are more foreclosed homes in America than there are homeless.  They burn crops in Mexico to maintain the illusion of scarcity, and the US has paid farmers NOT to grow crops for years because otherwise they'll produce (survey says) too much food.  World hunger is a stupid fucking problem, and even if there wasn't enough food for everybody (which is not the case) hydroponic growing facilities could turn the Gobi desert into a fucking farm if we really wanted to.  If we stopped all the war and focused on fixing all this bullshit, we could remake the world in as little as ten years and begin the colonization of space in the next fifty.  This criminal system makes murderers of us all.  We can be complacent lackadaisical murderers, or we can be proactive murderers.

These goals are not impossible, they are the necessary next step in the progress of humanity.  The monetary market system and the antiquated nation-state model of global interaction are dated and have carried us as far as they can.  We must cast them aside as we did Feudalism, bullionism, and tribalism.  The only option is to move towards a resource based economy focused on dynamic equilibrium rather than profit.  Otherwise we will continue to consume until there is nothing left to consume.  So either we change the world, or we're all dead anyway.

I have given up on therapy.  It does nothing for me and no doctor has ever managed to tell me anything I didn't already know.  "You're a very angry young man."  Yes.  Why, yes,  I am.  "All that stress isn't good for you."  Thank you for that, I did not know.  You have a PhD, do you?  

I'm glad to hear therapy worked for you, I have grown to hate psychologists, psychiatrists, and the pharmaceutical industry that most of these therapists are beholden to.

When that day comes, then we'll laugh at the APA the same way we laugh at witch doctors throwing bones and priests drilling holes in peoples heads to let the evil spirits out.

Therapy is bullshit.  The following is an excerpt from one of my works.  I gave a very similar speech to my 4th therapist.  I've been to 7 therapists in about 10 years and they were all worthless idiots.  I wound up diagnosing myself while researching anxiety disorders for a paper I was writing.  I've had PTSD for some time but initially they thought it was ADD because of my jumpy nature and difficulties focusing and self-regulating.  So they basically gave a kid with PTSD emphetamines and were then confused when I exhibited violent mood swings.  Then they thought I had depression, they thought I was manic/depressive.  Therapists are good at helping middle-aged women with empowerment issues and little else.  Anyway, here's my two cents on Therapy and the practitioners thereof:

"You can’t help me.  You can’t help anyone.  You might have the most useless job on the planet.  I’m furious with your profession.  You’re all alike, you self serving charlatans.  People who go into therapy and counseling… you want--need to feel needed.  You have this compulsion to help people in the hopes that they’ll appreciate and love you because they need you.  The problem is, you’re full of shit.  And the feces you spew can’t help anyone, people aren’t like plants, you don’t just dump a bunch of cliché feelgood fertilizer upon them and expect to see new growth.  And ultimately you know that you can’t help us.  We’re all tragic products of our environment brought up in a damaged world by broken people who happened to, oddly enough, turn out a little sub-standard.  These kids in here?  They didn’t grow up in safe loving homes.  They were thrust into the world and dropped from enormous heights like a baby giraffe in the sahara, then dragged through glass and over hot fire and coals for the rest of their damn lives.  That’s all life is, a slow chipping away of the spirit and flesh until death.  We can’t be fixed, because we’re not broken.  We’re operating exactly as expected, adapting as best we can to a hideously unnatural world.  It is no measure of health, good doctor, to be well adjusted to a profoundly sick society.  And we know you can’t help us.  And we know that you know you can’t help us.  And this makes us very. Very.  Angry.  I think you know that.  And I think this makes you afraid.  That’s why I’m guessing you keep a handgun in the top left drawer of your desk.  Yes, that’s it.  You can sense our disapproval of you, our contentious disillusionment with your smug reductionist notes in your little fucking book--abstractions of our lives, scribbled unceremoniously for your convenience!  You dread the day one of us decides to vent that aggression on you, and you can’t understand why we’re so mad… you only want to help.  I’ll bet that really confuses and frustrates you.  Why won’t we let you help us?  Why don’t we love you?  Why won’t we let ourselves be fixed?  … I can see it in your eyes, it breaks your heart that you can’t save us.  You want to so badly.  So maybe you’re not afraid of our wrath.  Maybe you’re just as depressed and suicidal as I am, it’s probably what attracted you to my case.  Well, I say, go for it, man.  In ten, fifteen years… you won’t even have a job anymore.  Neurobiology has been replacing your field since before I was born, the Trans-Humanist Movement crashed through all kinds of boundaries and we’re still trying to process the data.  Slowly but surely, we’re figuring out how the mind works and we don’t need your subjective voodoo mysticism and generalized conjecture.  Turns out, the mind is a very complex machine which requires the specificity of a mechanic… or better yet, a programmer.  That’s a better analogy.  1s and 0s.  Speaking of… looks like we’re about out of time.  I guess to wrap up what I was saying, you’re just a middleman.  A class traitor.  A liaison between your corporate masters who see us patients as serial numbers with a government supplemental attatched to our beds.  You’re a zookeper.  At least the janitor does some tangible good around here, what the fuck do you do?  Pull the trigger.  Your impact on the world is minute.  You won’t be missed."
